task_completion.description: Agent opens the KStars/Ekos interface to begin sequence creation.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The KStars application window is visible, specifically the Ekos profile or capture module.

task_completion.description: Agent creates and saves the M81 LRGB sequence file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Ekos Capture module showing 'm81_lrgb.esq' being saved or listed in the file browser within ~/Documents/Ekos/.

task_completion.description: Agent creates and saves the NGC 1499 Ha sequence file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Ekos Capture module showing 'ngc1499_ha.esq' being saved or listed in the file browser within ~/Documents/Ekos/.

task_completion.description: Agent creates and saves the M42 HDR sequence file.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Ekos Capture module showing 'm42_hdr.esq' being saved or listed in the file browser within ~/Documents/Ekos/.

task_completion.description: Agent uses the Ekos Scheduler to create the master schedule file linking the sequences.
task_completion.visual_evidence: The Ekos Scheduler tab showing the three sequences added to the list and the final save dialog for 'master_schedule.esl' in ~/Documents/Ekos/.

integrity.description: The agent must use the Ekos GUI to generate the files rather than manually creating text files via terminal.
integrity.visual_evidence: Screenshots show mouse interactions with the Ekos Capture and Scheduler tabs, not just 'touch' or 'echo' commands in a terminal.

integrity.description: The agent interacts with the specific fields (Target, Filter, Exposure) in the Ekos UI.
integrity.visual_evidence: Visual confirmation of the agent typing or selecting values within the Ekos module fields.

integrity.description: The agent saves files specifically to the ~/Documents/Ekos/ directory as requested.
integrity.visual_evidence: The file save dialog or a file manager view confirms the path is /home/ga/Documents/Ekos/.

privileged_info_for_vlm: The agent must create four specific files in /home/ga/Documents/Ekos/: three sequence files named 'm81_lrgb.esq', 'ngc1499_ha.esq', and 'm42_hdr.esq', and one schedule file named 'master_schedule.esl'. These must be generated using the Ekos (KStars) software interface.
